description: Elizabeth Maier for State Representative in Ohio's 27th District Elizabeth Maier’s story starts the same place so many of ours do — with family. Long before she became a candidate for State Representative, she was raised in a sixth-generation Cincinnati manufacturing business where the lessons came early and stuck for life: work hard, treat people well, and take responsibility.
